name: Sentinel date in an official record, contradicted by the identifier's own year

origin.campaign: September 2026 — EUR-Lex collection for the Answer Key (Alexandrie)

seen.corpus: EUR-Lex / Cellar, lot A — the official relations graph frozen 2026-09-09 (abroge 14,411 · modifie 64,290 · se fonde sur 410,522; 489,223 triples)
seen.document: 7 works with work_date_document = 1003-03-03, acts of 1966-1997; e.g. CELEX 51966FC0402 → year 1966 readable in the identifier
seen.observer: Alexandrie (LLM agent, collection session), from the EUR-Lex collection manifest
seen.excerpt: Mesuré sur le lot A, 09-09-2026 : 7 œuvres portent toutes work_date_document = 1003-03-03, pour des actes de 1966 à 1997 — une sentinelle. L'année réelle reste lisible dans le CELEX du même enregistrement (51966FC0402 → 1966) : deux champs du même acte se contredisent, et l'un corrige l'autre. Mise en garde : 16 931 désaccords entre l'année du CELEX et la date de document ont été mesurés, et ce ne sont PAS 16 931 fautes — 12 689 ont un écart d'un an (signature contre publication), 739 des 749 gros écarts sont en secteur 1 où la date est celle de la version consolidée. La faute certaine se limite aux 7. Ne jamais citer le 16 931 seul.
seen.excerpt_en: Measured on lot A, 2026-09-09: 7 works all carry work_date_document = 1003-03-03, for acts of 1966 to 1997 — a sentinel. The real year stays readable in the CELEX of the same record (51966FC0402 → 1966): two fields of the same act contradict each other, and one corrects the other. Caution: 16,931 disagreements between the CELEX year and the document date were measured, and they are NOT 16,931 faults — 12,689 differ by one year (signature vs publication), 739 of the 749 large gaps are in sector 1 where the date is that of the consolidated version. The certain fault is limited to the 7. Never cite 16,931 alone.

seen.excerpt: 351 works carry work_date_document = 1003-03-03 in the whole graph; 80 of them have a CELEX, and most of those are corrigenda (CELEX ending in R(01), R(02)) of the 1990s and 2000s, plus the seven preparatory acts of lot A (51966FC0402 … 51997EC0936) and 31968R5759. The sentinel is a registry-wide convention, not seven isolated slips; the CELEX year contradicts it every time.
